name: net.youmi.overseas.offers.mvp.ui.activity.YoumiWithdrawDetailActivity
description: After a user selects a Youmi point-redemption option, this screen shows its point cost and payout method, collects the required contact details, and submits the redemption.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to redeem Youmi points through this screen, while the host app’s other features remain available.
